images.title: Three views of 4 cubes
images.purpose: Shows a stack of 4 cubes (3 in a row, 1 on top of the left cube) and its front, top and side views.
images.composition: Plain white background with generous empty margins; the main object is large and centred and fills about 60 percent of the frame; nothing else is drawn. The stack large in the top centre; its three views in a row below it, evenly spaced.
images.exact_structure: Top centre: 4 identical cubes drawn flat in a simple corner view, filled teal #0072B2 with thin dark outlines: 3 cubes in a row on the floor, left to right, and 1 more cube on top of the left cube. Below, a row of three views made of equal amber #E69F00 squares with thin dark outlines: left, 3 squares in a row with 1 square on top of the left one (an L of 4 squares), labelled 'front' under it; middle, 3 squares in a row, labelled 'top' under it; right, 2 squares in a column, labelled 'side' under it. In all 9 amber squares. Nothing else.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Each view shows one square for every column of cubes seen from that direction.
images.description: Shows a stack of 4 cubes (3 in a row, 1 on top of the left cube) and its front, top and side views.
images.context: Concept T11.C2; one image that shows only the main idea.
images.teaching_notes: Front: L of 4; top: the top cube hides the one under it, row of 3; side from the left: column of 2.

image_decisions.why: Views of a stack are drawn by looking along each direction; the stack beside its three views shows the rule.
